decisions.reason: Having survived its first review and fitting tightly with the firm's market-data and analytics platform, this add-on still looks inexpensive to carry and worth keeping as a now more credible option.

The gas tariff comparison product remains close to the core offer, and after another year on the market a medium-sized German sector-software firm would usually retain it unless results had clearly disappointed.

This electricity tariff calculator sits very near the firm's established calculation and process-support capabilities, and its continued presence after earlier portfolio pruning suggests enough traction to justify retention.

Although somewhat more niche than the tariff tools, the area definition product builds on existing data and process know-how and is still likely cheap enough to keep while the firm continues learning about demand.
